kind: Conceitos de direção de arte e HUD; valores ilustrativos

prompts.combate:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: finished painted fantasy RPG game screenshot concept, landscape 16:9, high resolution.
Primary request: Create a beautiful, clearly game-like desktop turn-based RPG battle screen using ORIGINAL bespoke illustrated interface art. This is an in-game screenshot, full bleed, not a browser, website, dashboard, tablet, poster or UI wireframe. The prior concepts looked too much like websites; decisively replace that visual language.
Input images: Image 1 is character design reference only: preserve this knight's dark steel and antique gold armor, red plume and cape, sword and shield silhouette. Image 2 is enemy design reference only: preserve the dark wolf, purple spectral smoke and bronze armor. Image 3 is forest environment reference only: lush magical forest, painterly style and green clearing. Compose a new game screen using these references.
Art direction: cohesive illustrated medieval fantasy, painterly 2D game art, worn dark iron, aged bronze, subtly embossed leather, hand-carved wood, restrained vine motifs, fine engraved corners. Materials feel handcrafted and physical. Warm amber candles and sunlight contrast with moss green forest and violet enemy magic. Polished premium PC RPG interface, excellent hierarchy and readable short Portuguese labels.
Composition: immersive forest battle fills the upper two thirds, knight on the left and spectral wolf on the right with breathing room; environment extends behind HUD. Small metal-framed location name centered at top "Floresta Sombria". Small turn pennant beneath it "Sua vez". Character portrait medallions and sculpted ruby health and sapphire mana bars nested at lower edges of the scene: knight "Guerreiro · Nv. 40", "420 / 600", "72 / 180"; wolf "Lobo Sombrio", "88 / 88". Bottom fifth is an illustrated leather-and-bronze command belt: FOUR LARGE framed illustrated ability icons (sword strike, glowing healing breath, shield bash, stunning impact), each with readable exact labels "Atacar", "Recuperar Fôlego", "Esbarrão", "Contundir", and small costs "0 MP", "38 MP", "52 MP", "48 MP". A small potion slot on one side, discreet "Passar" and "Fugir" on the other. Slim one-line battle chronicle above the belt. A small parchment quest tracker top-right with "Cace Lobos Sombrios" and "3 / 7"; compact rolled-map icon top-left. Discreet bottom tabs engraved into the belt "Aventura", "Personagem", "Bolsa", "Aldeia" with illustrative icons. No giant menu blocking scenery.
Typography: legible fantasy serif headings, restrained highly readable smaller lettering; correct Portuguese. Make the four ability icons and physical frames a focal point of craftsmanship.
Constraints: entire game screen visible with no cropping; enough contrast on all labels; no browser chrome, web cards, rounded SaaS buttons, spreadsheet tables, flat vector placeholders, sci-fi framing, external logos, watermark or promotional title. No extra party members. Values are illustrative.
prompts.oficina:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: finished painted fantasy RPG crafting screen concept, landscape 16:9, high resolution.
Primary request: Create a beautiful in-game blacksmith crafting interface that unmistakably belongs to an illustrated medieval fantasy RPG. Full bleed game screenshot, NOT a website, web dashboard, app mockup, browser window or a poster.
Art direction consistent with battle concept: bespoke painterly 2D art, worn blackened iron, aged bronze edging, embossed dark leather, hand-carved wood, fine engraved corners and subtle forest vine motifs. Rich physical materials, restrained ornamentation, warm amber forge lighting with moss green details. Premium readable PC RPG.
Scene: a lived-in village forge with warm embers, anvil, hanging tools and a large workbench. A dark-steel and antique-gold armored knight with a red cape is subtly visible at the left edge as the player silhouette. The environment remains visible around the UI.
Composition: top small carved sign "Oficina". Left quarter: an opened travel map pinned to a wooden rack with an illustrated green forest region selected, label "Floresta"; two subdued region thumbnails beneath, no text needed for them. Adjacent slim vertical rack of FIVE individual illustrated equipment slots: sword, hood/helmet, chestplate, trousers, boots, with sword selected by a thin warm bronze glow. Center: a forest-themed sword with vine-wrapped grip and green stone lies on an illuminated anvil as a detailed item illustration, title above "Espada da Floresta", subtitle "Raízes Vivas · Comum". Right quarter: parchment recipe fixed with metal rivets and extremely readable dark ink, short stat lines "Vida +22", "Mana +23", "Poder +2". Two physical metal-edged tabs "Fabricar" selected, "Aprimorar" unselected. Materials as actual small painted item icons: wolf fur "Pelo do Lobo · 5 / 5", fang "Presa Sombria · 1 / 1", coin "Moedas · 248 / 50". Clear ornate but usable main button "Fabricar comum". Small rarity progression in order below the item: "Comum → Incomum → Rara → Ultrarrara → Lendária". Bottom-left, a restrained leather-backed set summary "Raízes Vivas · 3 / 5", "2 peças: +6% de mana", "4 peças: +8% de dano periódico". Bottom navigation consists of small engraved icon tabs "Aventura", "Personagem", "Bolsa", "Aldeia". Small in-world service plaque links "Oficina", "Pousada", "Mercenário", no web header.
Constraints: crafting always makes common gear; sequential upgrading indicated, no choose-rarity selector and no stat profile dropdown. Same sword shown on anvil and selected slot. Readable Portuguese, no giant paragraphs, decorative fake letters or tiny clutter. Full screen visible. No browser chrome, web cards, flat vector placeholder icons, generic SaaS pill buttons, modern website layout, watermark or external game logos. Values are illustrative.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved-for-this-study battle concept, used ONLY as reference for the interface art direction, illustrated material treatment, knight appearance, bottom navigation and readable lettering. Do not reproduce its combat layout or wolf. Image 2 is the new matching UI asset sheet, use its bronze/iron/leather/parchment craft consistently. Create the full workshop scene requested above.
prompts.kit:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: reusable fantasy RPG UI art asset sheet with a genuine transparent background (alpha), landscape composition, high resolution.
Primary request: Draw ORIGINAL production-style painterly 2D fantasy RPG interface elements as individually separated assets, with generous transparent gutters so each can be cut out independently. No example screen, no background scenery, no contact shadow across empty alpha areas. The sheet must look like handcrafted GAME HUD art, never like a website UI kit.
Art direction: blackened iron and aged bronze, embossed oxblood leather, hand-carved dark walnut, delicate engraved corners and subtle forest vine motifs, premium medieval fantasy matching a dark-armored knight and magical forest. Rich but restrained texture. Top-down frontal orthographic UI sprites, crisp silhouettes, no perspective tilt.
Contents arranged neatly in rows: (1) one long empty ornate command-belt frame with four square sockets; (2) one empty rectangular panel frame with parchment center and bronze corners; (3) a circular portrait frame attached to a long EMPTY ruby-health bar trough, and a separate EMPTY sapphire-mana bar trough; (4) six independent square framed painted icons, recognizable sword strike, shield bash, healing breath, stunning hammer impact, red potion bottle, rolled parchment map; (5) three independent empty material-framed buttons in normal, gold-highlighted, and subdued states; (6) a decorative thin horizontal separator and four small corner ornaments. All bars empty in the sense of no text/numerals, but may have red/blue gem fill to show material. Four ability icons must be clear distinct paintings, not flat pictograms.
Constraints: NO text, labels, numbers, logos, watermark, checkerboard baked into the artwork or opaque sheet background. Genuinely transparent alpha outside every asset. Keep all elements wholly within canvas, no overlaps, generous transparent margins. Do not draw characters or full scenery.
